blast_radius: A stalled gate pipeline blocks all landing; candidate branches are unaffected.

throughput.derivation: loops.daily_counts()/window_count() over the loopqueue ledger (gitignored; read directly since plain rg skips it without -uu). Only covered days are sampled; absent days are never zero-padded.

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: Gate/landing pipeline; volume is submitted+gated+admitted+merged ledger events.
why_it_matters: This is the estate's actual shipping rate. It is currently running and well below its own trailing floor, which no liveness check would have shown.
